description: Audit and optimize Local AI Hub preprocessing. Preserve incremental watcher behavior; never clear every project's cache as a side effect of a major-change heuristic; hash changed candidates and reuse content-addressed file, module, project, and RAG caches; invalidate only stale dependent results.

acceptance_criteria: Trace current preprocessing phase triggers and state transitions; distinguish watcher availability from incremental run-mode flags.
Preserve incremental watcher behavior, project path confinement, cancellation/preemption and scheduler fairness.
No major-change heuristic clears all project caches; matching identities reuse cached file/module/project/RAG work and only stale dependents regenerate.
Measure or attribute significant costs in inventory, hashing, lexical/code indexing, cards, RAG, SQLite and background model scheduling before optimizing.
Implement evidence-backed high-value improvements without changing preprocessing provider or pulling models; add focused regression coverage.
Run affected targeted validation and record runtime evidence plus explicit unverified limits.
